name: Grim Reaper
source:
"I don’t get people’s misery over death. It is a part of life. For some of you, it simply comes sooner."

A god who slacks at putting souls to rest.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/sinxholic/status/1649578261125517312]Twitter[/url]]
